num_steps.label: Steps
num_steps.help: Number of sampling steps. More steps improve quality but take longer.

num_candidates.label: Candidates
num_candidates.help: How many variations of the same text to generate at once. More candidates use more VRAM.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: The same seed with the same settings reproduces the same audio. Leave empty for a random seed.

t_schedule_mode.label: Time schedule
t_schedule_mode.help: How sampling steps are spaced. Sway keeps quality up when you use fewer steps.

sway_coeff.label: Sway coefficient
sway_coeff.help: Negative values put more steps on the noise side (the early steps).

truncation_factor.label: Truncation factor
truncation_factor.help: Scales the initial noise. 0.8–0.9 reduces variation but can flatten expression.

rescale_k.label: Rescale k
rescale_k.help: Temporal score rescaling. Set it together with sigma.

rescale_sigma.label: Rescale sigma
rescale_sigma.help: Temporal score rescaling. Set it together with k.

context_kv_cache.label: Context KV cache
context_kv_cache.help: Precomputes the conditioning for faster sampling.

seconds.label: Duration (s)
seconds.help: Fixes the output length. Leave empty to let the duration predictor decide (recommended).

duration_scale.label: Duration scale
duration_scale.help: Multiplies the predicted length. Above 1 is slower and longer; below 1 is faster and shorter.

cfg_guidance_mode.label: CFG mode
cfg_guidance_mode.help: Independent gives each condition its own strength; joint needs all enabled strengths to be equal.

cfg_scale_text.label: CFG: text
cfg_scale_text.help: How strongly to follow the text. Raise it a little if pronunciation is weak.

cfg_scale_caption.label: CFG: caption
cfg_scale_caption.help: How strongly to follow the caption (voice and style).

cfg_scale_speaker.label: CFG: speaker
cfg_scale_speaker.help: How closely to match the reference speaker.

cfg_scale.label: CFG override (deprecated)
cfg_scale.help: Overrides every enabled CFG strength with this value. Normally leave it empty.

cfg_min_t.label: CFG min t
cfg_min_t.help: CFG is applied only while t is at or above this value.

cfg_max_t.label: CFG max t
cfg_max_t.help: CFG is applied only while t is at or below this value.

speaker_kv_scale.label: Speaker K/V scale
speaker_kv_scale.help: Values above 1 strengthen the reference speaker's identity (experimental).

speaker_kv_min_t.label: Speaker K/V min t
speaker_kv_min_t.help: Speaker K/V scaling applies only while t is at or above this value.

speaker_kv_max_layers.label: Speaker K/V layers
speaker_kv_max_layers.help: Limits the scaling to the first N layers.

speaker_uncond_mode.label: Speaker uncond mode
speaker_uncond_mode.help: How the unconditional speaker branch is formed when a speaker embedding is used.

ref_normalize_db.label: Reference loudness (dB)
ref_normalize_db.help: Normalizes the reference loudness before encoding. The default of -16 dB is recommended.

ref_ensure_max.label: Reference peak guard
ref_ensure_max.help: When normalization is off, turns down references whose peaks exceed 1.0.

max_ref_seconds.label: Reference limit (s)
max_ref_seconds.help: Maximum length of reference audio to use. Empty uses the model's recommendation.

max_text_len.label: Max text tokens
max_text_len.help: Longer text is truncated. Normally leave it empty (the model default).

max_caption_len.label: Max caption tokens
max_caption_len.help: Longer captions are truncated. Normally leave it empty (the model default).

decode_mode.label: Decode mode
decode_mode.help: Sequential decodes one candidate at a time and saves VRAM; batch decodes them together and is faster.

trim_tail.label: Trim tail
trim_tail.help: Cuts the flat (silent) tail off the generated audio.

tail_window_size.label: Tail window
tail_window_size.help: Window length, in latent frames, used to detect the flat tail.

tail_std_threshold.label: Tail std threshold
tail_std_threshold.help: Stretches that vary less than this count as flat.

tail_mean_threshold.label: Tail mean threshold
tail_mean_threshold.help: Stretches whose mean is within this distance of zero count as flat.

runtime.hint: Changing these reloads the model; the Settings screen will offer it in an upcoming version.

errors.above_cfg_max_t: The minimum must not exceed the maximum
errors.joint_requires_equal_scales: Joint mode needs all enabled CFG strengths to be equal
errors.unknown: This setting is not available for this model
